package recording_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	foreignBinding "example.test/generated/api/go/foreign-binding"
	foreignClient "example.test/generated/api/go/foreign-client"
	foreignProtocol "example.test/generated/api/go/foreign-protocol"
	binding "example.test/generated/api/go/history-binding"
	client "example.test/generated/api/go/history-client"
	protocol "example.test/generated/api/go/history-protocol"
	"github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/duplex/go"
	"github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/runtime/go"
	"os"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type destination struct{ values chan int64 }

func isCode(err error, code string) bool {
	var public *runtime.PublicError
	return errors.As(err, &public) && public.Code == code
}
func (d destination) Tick(_ context.Context, value protocol.Payload) error {
	d.values <- value.Value
	return nil
}

type foreignDestination struct{ values chan int64 }

func (d foreignDestination) Tick(_ context.Context, value foreignProtocol.Payload) error {
	d.values <- value.Value
	return nil
}

type reverse struct{ values chan string }

func (r reverse) Subscribe(_ context.Context, s protocol.Subscription) (int64, error) {
	return s.After, nil
}
func (r reverse) Tick(_ context.Context, value string) error { r.values <- value; return nil }
func next[T comparable](t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, values <-chan T, want T) {
	t.Helper()
	select {
	case value := <-values:
		if value != want {
			t.Fatalf("got %v want %v", value, want)
		}
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
}
func target(t *testing.T) (duplex.Wire, chan int64) {
	t.Helper()
	values := make(chan int64, 16)
	wire, err := client.ToWire(func(protocol.Server) (protocol.Client, error) {
		return protocol.Client{Events: destination{values}}, nil
	}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { wire.Close(1000, "done") })
	return wire, values
}
func TestTypedRecordFollow(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	wire, values := target(t)
	store := duplex.NewMemoryWireLog()
	recorded, err := binding.Record(ctx, wire, store, duplex.RecordOptions{}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer recorded.Close(1000, "done")
	for _, value := range []int64{1, 2} {
		if err := recorded.Append(ctx, binding.RecordedTick{Data: protocol.Payload{Value: value}}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	head, err := recorded.Head(ctx)
	if err != nil || head != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("head %d %v", head, err)
	}
	next(t, ctx, values, int64(1))
	next(t, ctx, values, int64(2))
	second, followed := target(t)
	follower, err := recorded.Follow(ctx, 1, second)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer follower.Close()
	if follower.Head != 2 {
		t.Fatal(follower.Head)
	}
	next(t, ctx, followed, int64(2))
	if err := recorded.Append(ctx, binding.RecordedTick{Data: protocol.Payload{Value: 3}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	next(t, ctx, values, int64(3))
	next(t, ctx, followed, int64(3))
	if err := recorded.Append(ctx, nil); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("nil union accepted")
	}
	// Same event spelling in the opposite direction keeps its distinct type.
	reversed := make(chan string, 2)
	back, err := binding.ToWire(func(protocol.Client) (protocol.Server, error) {
		r := reverse{reversed}
		return protocol.Server{Methods: r, Events: r}, nil
	}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer back.Close(1000, "done")
	backRecord, err := client.Record(ctx, back, duplex.NewMemoryWireLog(), duplex.RecordOptions{}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer backRecord.Close(1000, "done")
	if err := backRecord.Append(ctx, client.RecordedTick{Data: "reverse"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	next(t, ctx, reversed, "reverse")
}
func TestIdentityBeforeHistoryAndFailedSetupCleanup(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	values := make(chan int64, 4)
	foreign, err := foreignClient.ToWire(func(foreignProtocol.Server) (foreignProtocol.Client, error) {
		return foreignProtocol.Client{Events: foreignDestination{values}}, nil
	}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer foreign.Close(1000, "done")
	store := duplex.NewMemoryWireLog()
	if _, err := binding.Record(ctx, foreign, store, duplex.RecordOptions{}, runtime.AdapterContext{}); !isCode(err, "contract_mismatch") {
		t.Fatalf("record mismatch: %v", err)
	}
	if head, err := store.Head(ctx); err != nil || head != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("setup touched history %d %v", head, err)
	}
	wire, _ := target(t)
	recorded, err := binding.Record(ctx, wire, store, duplex.RecordOptions{}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer recorded.Close(1000, "done")
	recorded.Append(ctx, binding.RecordedTick{Data: protocol.Payload{Value: 1}})
	if _, err := recorded.Follow(ctx, 0, foreign); !isCode(err, "contract_mismatch") {
		t.Fatalf("follow mismatch: %v", err)
	}
	select {
	case <-values:
		t.Fatal("mismatch ran an event handler")
	default:
	}
	// Neither rejected interpretation kept a registration or closed the target.
	accepted, err := foreignBinding.Record(ctx, foreign, duplex.NewMemoryWireLog(), duplex.RecordOptions{}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer accepted.Close(1000, "done")
	if err := accepted.Append(ctx, foreignBinding.RecordedTick{Data: foreignProtocol.Payload{Value: 9}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	next(t, ctx, values, int64(9))
}

type heldLog struct {
	*duplex.MemoryWireLog
	entered, release chan struct{}
	once             sync.Once
}

func (l *heldLog) Read(ctx context.Context, sequence uint64) (duplex.WireRecord, error) {
	l.once.Do(func() { close(l.entered) })
	select {
	case <-l.release:
		return l.MemoryWireLog.Read(ctx, sequence)
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return duplex.WireRecord{}, ctx.Err()
	}
}
func TestGeneratedAtomicHeadTable(t *testing.T) {
	var table struct {
		Cases []struct {
			Name                     string
			Before, During, Expected []int64
			After, Head              uint64
		}
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile("recorded-wire.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &table); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, row := range table.Cases {
		t.Run(row.Name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			wire, _ := target(t)
			store := &heldLog{MemoryWireLog: duplex.NewMemoryWireLog(), entered: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{})}
			recorded, err := binding.Record(ctx, wire, store, duplex.RecordOptions{MaxQueuedMessages: 8}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer recorded.Close(1000, "done")
			appendValue := func(value int64) {
				t.Helper()
				if err := recorded.Append(ctx, binding.RecordedTick{Data: protocol.Payload{Value: value}}); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			for _, value := range row.Before {
				appendValue(value)
			}
			subscriber, values := target(t)
			follower, err := recorded.Follow(ctx, row.After, subscriber)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer follower.Close()
			if follower.Head != row.Head {
				t.Fatal(follower.Head)
			}
			select {
			case <-store.entered:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
			}
			for _, value := range row.During {
				appendValue(value)
			}
			if head, err := recorded.Head(ctx); err != nil || head != uint64(len(row.Before)+len(row.During)) {
				t.Fatalf("producer did not advance: %d %v", head, err)
			}
			close(store.release)
			for _, value := range row.Expected {
				next(t, ctx, values, value)
			}
			appendValue(99)
			next(t, ctx, values, int64(99))
		})
	}
}

func TestGeneratedSlowFollowerIsIsolated(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	source, original := target(t)
	log := &heldLog{MemoryWireLog: duplex.NewMemoryWireLog(), entered: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{})}
	recorded, err := binding.Record(ctx, source, log, duplex.RecordOptions{MaxQueuedMessages: 2}, runtime.AdapterContext{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer recorded.Close(1000, "")
	appendValue := func(value int64) {
		t.Helper()
		if err := recorded.Append(ctx, binding.RecordedTick{Data: protocol.Payload{Value: value}}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := recorded.Head(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		next(t, ctx, original, value)
	}
	appendValue(1)
	slowTarget, _ := target(t)
	slow, err := recorded.Follow(ctx, 0, slowTarget)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer slow.Close()
	select {
	case <-log.entered:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	fastTarget, fastValues := target(t)
	fast, err := recorded.Follow(ctx, 1, fastTarget)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer fast.Close()
	for _, value := range []int64{2, 3, 4} {
		appendValue(value)
		next(t, ctx, fastValues, value)
	}
	select {
	case <-slow.Done:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	if !errors.Is(slow.Err(), duplex.ErrRecordOverflow) {
		t.Fatalf("slow follower: %v", slow.Err())
	}
	appendValue(5)
	next(t, ctx, fastValues, int64(5))
}
